verdict.rationale: Angular's docs claim fine-grained reactivity via Signals for fast state updates, and the CLI compiles applications. A production user also credits AOT compilation and great performance, and another reports strong rendering benchmarks. Together these imply compiler-driven, targeted DOM updates, but no evidence explicitly describes the compiler turning templates into surgical DOM update code. missing for 10: first-party documentation of how the template compiler generates targeted DOM update instructions, explicit linkage between Signals and surgical DOM patching, current hands-on corroboration (community reports are from the Angular 2 era).
